THE MEMORY BOOK

A life in the making

An original Life-inspired adventure · 2–4 players · Online multiplayer with room codes
PLAY FROM YOUR OWN DEVICE

Join the journey

Create a room or enter a room code from your host. Two to four human players can join.

A few rules for the road

Play with 2–4 players. Each player helps their own assigned patient and takes turns spinning the wheel.

The spinner has eight sections: 1, 2, 3, 4, 1, 2, 3, 4. Earn the displayed number of Life points and travel up to that many spaces. Complete every question along the way, in order.

Each question appears in a pop-up when you reach its space. Choose an answer and read the feedback before continuing.

Red STOP spaces are event cards, not quiz questions. Read the card and complete its decision. Follow the instructions displayed on your card before proceeding. You cannot spin again while a card is waiting.

Payday spaces pay your salary. Some spaces involve another player. Money, Life points, and joy are tracked separately.

Final score = cash + $10,000 per joy point + $1 per Life point. Any home is sold for its listed value at retirement. The highest final score wins once the game is complete.

Your shared game saves on the server. Keep your original device and browser to reconnect.
